svg.title: AI Project Management Copilot Architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture diagram showing user interaction, agent orchestration, specialized sub-agents, tool integrations, and data layer for an agentic AI software development PM copilot.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the chat interface')
sendPrompt('What is the PM dashboard used for?')
sendPrompt('What IDE integrations does the copilot support?')
sendPrompt('What are CLI commands for the copilot?')
sendPrompt('How does the orchestrator agent work?')
g.text: Planning · task routing · memory management · goal tracking
